notes.title: UPDATE 1.4
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho!

Here's a new update v 1.4 with some small changes:

-Added: Stats counter for some achievements.
You can see your unlock progress in the Main Menu - Trophy room.

-Fixed: bug with some Achievements.
The stats were only counted if the player died or finished the game. But if you paused the game and went to the main menu, they were not counted for some achievements.

-A few minor bugs and issues fixed.



Happy Gaming!

@FobTi

notes.title: UPDATE 1.3
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho!

Here's a new update v 1.3 with some important changes that will improve gameplay:

-Added: Option to On/Off Flashing VFX.
Bazooka, Grenade Launcher and other explosive weapons are now eyes friendly :)

-Added: A small HP bar above the Gingerbread (mid-boss) head.

-Added/Changed: HP for Elf.  Surprise! Yes, Elf is now mortal.
Don't be too much greedy, don't shoot at him non-stop. Elf is not Your enemy!
(btw Elf spawn every 30 sec.)

-Changed: Stopped spawning the Christmas Elf during the boss battle with Krampus.
If there was an Elf there, it was harder to target the boss with Auto-Aim.

-A few minor bugs and issues fixed.

ps. Still working on the SteamDeck controls problem. I hope i'll fix it soon.

Have fun, folks!

@FobTi

notes.title: UPDATE 1.2
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho!

- Added: Finally! :D Option to Re-roll lvl-up upgrades. (cost 25 coins per roll)

Happy gaming!

@FobTi

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
Ho Ho Ho!

Here's a NEW update v1.1 with some important changes. I hope you enjoy it!


-AddedNEW lvl-up upgrade for bigger presents opening zone
-Added NEW lvl-up upgrade for increase weapon range
-Added NEW lvl-up upgrade for faster DASH recharge
-Added NEW lvl-up upgrade for Pets: X - Collar (fires every 3 sec. on nearby enemies)

-Changed and completely redesigned shooting system.
Now, You are only slower if you hold down the fire button. The old system was based on sprite animations, so the player was slowed down until the animation finished. This resulted in enemies hitting the player more often.

-Changed: Faster Reloading and Firerate speed for Bazooka and Crossbow.

-Fixed: Krampus HP bar in Hard mode

-Fixed: A few minor bugs and animation issues.


Have fun, folks!

@FobTi
